lines: Q: What's the hardest part of meals for you? Or something else.
A: The menu every morning, honestly. Mala asks and I never know what to say.

Q: Which apps do you order groceries on: Zepto, Blinkit, Instamart, BigBasket or Amazon? If you sign me in, I'll read your past orders to learn what your home buys and how often, so the plan and the shopping list fit you from the first week, and I can fill the cart for you. Nothing is ordered without your yes.
A: Blinkit mostly, and fish from the bazaar.
A: Sign in later, let's just set up the plan for now.
Q: Which is your main app, and which do you use when something isn't there?
A: Blinkit's the main one. Zepto sometimes if Blinkit doesn't have it.
Q: I have Sourav (42), Rituparna (40), Riya (12), Pradip (72) and Gita (68) eating at home. Anyone else who eats at home, or anyone who doesn't?
A: No, that's all of us. Just the five.
Q: Mala cooks every day: Breakfast and Lunch at 8am, Dinner at 6pm. Is that right, and does the cook come for any other meals?
A: Yes, that's right. Breakfast and lunch at 8, dinner at 6. No other meals.
Q: Is the cook short of time, say off to the next house, so only a dish or two in the morning?
A: No, she has time. She does full meals both times.
A: sorry, Mala comes at 8:30 in the morning, not 8
Q: The cook comes every day: is food cooked at home all seven days?
A: Yes, all seven days at home.
Q: What did the children have for breakfast over the past week? Tell me in as much detail as you can.
A: Riya had toast and egg most days, or muri. Sunday she had luchi.
Q: The children's lunch over the past week, or their school tiffin?
A: Riya takes tiffin Monday to Friday: egg roll, chowmein, sandwich. Lunch at home after school, same as ours.
Q: The children's dinner over the past week?
A: Same as ours, roti with torkari and dal, sometimes fish.
Q: What did the adults have for breakfast over the past week? Tell me in as much detail as you can.
A: Toast and egg, muri, chire bhaja. Sunday luchi with alur dom.
Q: The adults' lunch over the past week?
A: Bhaat, dal, ekta bhaja, ekta torkari ar maacher jhol. Rui or katla most days. Sunday kosha mangsho.
Q: The adults' dinner over the past week?
A: Roti with a torkari and dal, sometimes fish. Ma has her own veg torkari.
Q: Is anyone on a diet? High protein, low carb, diabetic, anything a doctor asked for.
A: Baba is diabetic, no sweets at all. Ma is vegetarian, no fish, meat, eggs, onion or garlic.
Q: Do the elders eat anything differently from the rest: less salt, softer food, no onion or garlic, a fasting day?
A: Ma's vegetarian, no onion or garlic, told you. Baba eats everything but less oil, no sweets.
Q: Any food rules for the house? Veg, egg or non-veg days, fasting days, allergies, a dish someone won't touch.
A: No beef or pork in the house. That's it.
A: No fixed veg days or fasting.
Q: How often do you order in, and on which days?
A: Rarely, maybe Saturday dinner sometimes. No fixed day.
Q: Does anything come on a subscription, like Country Delight or a milkman?
A: Milk packets every morning. Nothing else on subscription.
